nodes.name: power_9v
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter stepping VIN_5V up to VBOOST_9V specifically for the preamplifier. EN tied high for always-on operation. Requires external inductor, diode, and feedback divider to set the 9V output.

nodes.name: SW
nodes.description: Power switch output, drain of internal MOSFET, connects to inductor and output rectifier, swings between GND and 28V

nodes.name: GND
nodes.description: Ground pin, connect to strong ground plane for heat sinking

nodes.name: FB
nodes.description: Feedback input, 0.6V reference voltage, connect resistor divider for output voltage setting

nodes.name: EN
nodes.description: Regulator enable input, active high (VIH>=1.5V, VIL<=0.4V), connect to VIN for automatic startup

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: No connect, leave floating, do not connect to any net

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 linear regulator stepping VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3. Provides power for the MCU and DAC digital/analog logic. Requires input and output bypass capacitors.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P microcontroller running on VCC_3V3. Acts as I2C master to configure the DAC. This module owns the I2C bus pull-up resistors. Ground connections should tie to the digital branch of the star ground.

nodes.name: PC6
nodes.description: Port C bit 6 / RESET input (active low), I/O if RSTDISBL fuse programmed

nodes.name: PD0
nodes.description: Port D bit 0, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD1
nodes.description: Port D bit 1, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD2
nodes.description: Port D bit 2, digital I/O with internal pull-up, INT0 interrupt

nodes.name: PD3
nodes.description: Port D bit 3, digital I/O with internal pull-up, INT1 interrupt

nodes.name: PD4
nodes.description: Port D bit 4, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB6
nodes.description: Port B bit 6 / XTAL1 input, oscillator amplifier input or TOSC1

nodes.name: PB7
nodes.description: Port B bit 7 / XTAL2 output, oscillator amplifier output or TOSC2

nodes.name: PD5
nodes.description: Port D bit 5, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD6
nodes.description: Port D bit 6, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PD7
nodes.description: Port D bit 7, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB0
nodes.description: Port B bit 0, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB1
nodes.description: Port B bit 1, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB2
nodes.description: Port B bit 2, digital I/O with internal pull-up

nodes.name: PB3
nodes.description: Port B bit 3, digital I/O with internal pull-up, MOSI/SPI

nodes.name: PB4
nodes.description: Port B bit 4, digital I/O with internal pull-up, MISO/SPI

nodes.name: PB5
nodes.description: Port B bit 5, digital I/O with internal pull-up, SCK/SPI

nodes.name: AVCC
nodes.description: Analog supply voltage for ADC and PC3:0, should connect to VCC via low-pass filter

nodes.name: AREF
nodes.description: Analog reference pin for A/D Converter

nodes.name: PC0
nodes.description: Port C bit 0 / ADC0, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC1
nodes.description: Port C bit 1 / ADC1, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC2
nodes.description: Port C bit 2 / ADC2, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC3
nodes.description: Port C bit 3 / ADC3, analog input or digital I/O

nodes.name: PC4
nodes.description: Port C bit 4 / ADC4 / SDA, analog input, digital I/O, or I2C data

nodes.name: PC5
nodes.description: Port C bit 5 / ADC5 / SCL, analog input, digital I/O, or I2C clock

nodes.name: dac
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC. Receives commands from the MCU via I2C to generate a shared analog GAIN_CTRL/bias signal. A0 pin tied to set desired I2C address. Ground connection should tie to the analog branch of the star ground.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp forming the stereo preamplifier stage. Powered exclusively by VBOOST_9V. Takes LINE_IN_L/LINE_IN_R inputs (external) and outputs PREAMP_OUT_L/PREAMP_OUT_R. The DAC GAIN_CTRL signal biases the operational network for volume/gain intent. Ground connects to the analog star point.

nodes.name: power_amp
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W stereo Class-D amplifier. Powered directly from the global VIN_5V rail. Amplifies PREAMP_OUT signals to drive stereo speakers. Internally uses separate PGND and GND pins; both must route back to the system star ground appropriately. SHDN and MUTE pins should be tied inactive.

nodes.name: PVDD_1
nodes.description: Power Supply Input for Output Stage (pin 4)

nodes.name: MUTE
nodes.description: Mute Control Input, active low, internal pull-up

nodes.name: VREF
nodes.description: Internal Analog Reference, requires bypass capacitor to GND

nodes.name: SHDN
nodes.description: Shutdown Control Input, active low, internal pull-up

nodes.name: PVDD_2
nodes.description: Power Supply Input for Output Stage (pin 13)
